column1: # Linked units: whole source files that are compiled as one object (no -ffunction-sections)
# and linked at their original address, in source order. The build copies each unit's whole
# text range from the link, with no per-function placement and no immediate patching.
#   text_start  address of its first function
#   text_end    end of its last function, including the alignment padding (exclusive)
#   sections    other sections of the object and their original addresses, e.g. .data@00351eb8
#               ("-" for none). The unit's .ctors entry goes to the game's .ctors table by itself.
#   flags       extra compiler flags for this file only ("-" for none)
# How to convert another file: notes/linking.md
